notes.title: Pest Control Simulator Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
🎉 Pest Control Simulator Steam Page is Live! 

We’re excited to announce that the Steam Page for  Pest Control Simulator is now officially live! 🚀

🔗 Check it out here: Pest Control Simulator on Steam
🔍 Wishlist now to stay up-to-date with all the latest news and updates.

Pest Control Simulator offers players a chance to tackle pest infestations in homes with a highly realistic simulation experience. From tiny ants to large rats, you'll use a variety of equipment and chemicals to keep your environment pest-free.

Literally..

What to Expect:

[list]
[*] Realistic Pest Control Experience
[*] Diverse Equipment and Strategies
[*] Chemicals and Upgrades
[*] Increasing Difficulty
[/list]

Your feedback means the world to us, so don’t forget to Wishlist and Follow us on Steam to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, and announcements.

💬 Join the conversation on our Steam Community Hub and let us know what you’re most excited to see in Pest Control Simulator!
